build_CLIP_model_from_config: build a CLIP model from a named config with optional pretrained checkpoint loading
create_VisionTransformer_from_config: create a VisionTransformer from a named config with optional pretrained weights
encode_image_features: encode an image tensor into normalized features using a CLIP model
encode_text_features: encode a text token tensor into normalized features using a CLIP model
encode_video_features: encode a batch of video frames into pooled features using a CLIP model
